setup: The polynomial is factored into zeros whose multiplicities are \([[multiplicities]]\).

steps.say: The degree is the sum of the multiplicities: \([[degree]]\).
The distinct zeros are the roots \([[roots]]\), so there are \([[distinct]]\) of them.
The multiplicity of each zero is given by the exponent in its factor.

answer: The degree is [[degree]], there are [[distinct]] distinct zeros, and their multiplicities are [[multiplicities]].
